notes.title: LOUISIANA RETRO CON SUMMER AUGUST 2025
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44760507/b463ab026a966202fe5e8fb0a1af42933f1c10f2.jpg"][/img][/p][p]SPECIAL GUEST ANNOUNCEMENT JEREMY POURCY!  Please join us in welcoming back Jrago Studios founder Jeremy Pourcy to our guest lineup for LOUISIANA RETRO CON SUMMER 2025! [/p][p][/p][p]Jeremy Pourcy is the founder of the independent video game company Jrago Studios. He is also the creator of TWO retro-style side-scroller video games available NOW on Steam, the titles being "Jrago the Demon Hunter", and "Jrago II: Guardians of Eden". His inspiration and implemented gameplay mechanics are borrowed from the classic 2D platforming combat experience that "Metroidvania" fans have come to love.[/p][p][/p][p]His humble starts in creating games can be inspiring to some, as he is a self-taught video game designer! He has also written and composed all of the music for the game himself, which features some excellent tracks that heavy metal enthusiasts are sure to enjoy. In recent projects, Mr. Pourcy has confirmed that the Jrago series will be receiving a THIRD entry, with more information to be announced at a later time.[/p][p][/p][p]At Louisiana Retro Con this August, Jeremy will have a free-play station set up for anyone wishing to play either Jrago I or II, and attendees will have the opportunity to purchase a PHYSICAL COPY of both games![/p][p][/p][p]Come meet Jeremy Pourcy, and join us in celebrating the 40th anniversary of Super Mario Bros at LOUISIANA RETRO CON SUMMER 2025! [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://www.LouisianaRetroConvention.com"]https://www.LouisianaRetroConvention.com[/url][/p][p][/p][p] for more information![/p]

notes.title: LOUISIANA RETRO CON SPRING 2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43100733/35d34ce8dfeed00a4509e59f5177015e1183beb7.png[/img]

SPECIAL GUEST ANNOUNCEMENT
Jeremy Pourcy returns for a sequel at LOUISIANA RETRO CON SPRING 2024!
Jeremy is the founder of the indie video game company Jrago Studios. He is also the creator of the recently released Steam title, "JRAGO THE DEMON HUNTER". His inspiration and implemented gameplay mechanics are borrowed from the classic 2D platforming combat experience that "Metroidvania" fans have come to love. His humble starts in creating games can be inspiring to some, as he is a self-taught video game designer! He has also written and composed all of the music for the game himself, which features some excellent tracks that heavy metal fans are sure to enjoy. In recent projects, Mr. Pourcy has confirmed that the Jrago series will be receiving a sequel sometime in 2024, titled JRAGO II: GUARDIANS OF EDEN. He will be offering more information on this upcoming game, as well as playable demo stations for his projects available all weekend at the convention!
Come meet and greet with Jeremy Pourcy at our convention this SPRING! You do not want to miss out on Louisiana Retro Con's first-ever TWO DAY convention, returning to the legendary Morgan City Municipal Auditorium on MARCH 2ND FROM 10:30 AM - 6:30 PM, & MARCH 3RD FROM 11 AM - 5 PM IN 2024! Tickets at the door will only be $15 for SATURDAY, $10 for SUNDAY, or $20 for our NEW WEEKEND PASS! As always, children 12 and under are absolutely FREE!
FANS, get your preorder tickets NOW!
https://www.louisianaretroconvention.com/event-details/louisiana-retro-con-spring-2024?fbclid=IwAR1kFFgepvFTEteWL6U0CdPfFwQS8Cpi1O4kdR6Ca8WIelO31kj_TPTUCTw

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43100733/048f59e931403bd3bea417fa9eb89520e2048e76.jpg[/img]

Louisiana's one and only video game convention returns for the LARGEST show yet!
Louisiana Retro Con Spring 2024 is a video game-focused convention and nostalgia fest. Promoting a family-friendly atmosphere for children and adults of all ages, the event has something for everyone to enjoy. This is the first time that the event is TWO DAYS, so there will be a lot to see! The event will take place starting on March 2nd, 2024 (10:30 AM - 6:30 PM), and will end on March 3rd, 2024 (11 AM - 5 PM). We are proudly returning to the beautiful Morgan City Municipal Auditorium, and have the ENTIRE FACILITY available this time, offering even MORE space than ever before!
We also will have special appearances from CELEBRITIES for the first time, such as voice actor Andy Field (HandUnit and the Narrator from Five Nights at Freddy's), film actor Joseph Poliquin (Carl from the Five Nights at Freddy's movie) and Christian Stokes (Hank from the Five Nights at Freddy's movie)!
Attendees can expect FREE ALL-DAY ACCESS to the Retro Con Arcade area, which features 100's of retro video games to try out and play!
Feeling competitive? Enter one of our retro video game tournaments!
Shop with many excellent vendors selling items from across the ages, such as video games, movie memorabilia, retro toys, comic books, and much more!
Meet local artists and special guests from local communities and industries!
MULTIPLE local food trucks will be outside ON-SITE to serve hungry fans! Be sure to come hungry!

notes.title: JRAGO II GUARDIANS OF EDEN!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43100733/825f32c7ba60386761a2dec6548b5a23ba19d795.png[/img]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2704580/Jrago_II_Guardians_of_Eden/

DOWNLOAD THE JRAGO 2 DEMO Today!

Jrago is back in action with a new multiplayer adventure!

Jrago II Guardians of Eden is an indie Co-Op METROIDVANIA style 2D Platforming Action-Adventure Role Playing Game.
The darkness has once again returned, and this time Jrago teams up with his fellow guardians as they slay the evil demons and bring back the light!

Featuring an original soundtrack by "Jrago" the band of the same name, and a whole host of unlockable weapons, armor, magic spells, and more!
This direct sequel to Jrago The Demon Hunter features updated graphics, new abilities, new spells, and multiplayer Local CO-OP or Steam Remote Play Together!

This is the second game developed by Jrago Studios, a solo indie developer based in USA.

notes.title: LOUISIANA RETRO CON FALL 2023
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43100733/9bf8ec28a8561510f80ed44f0ea06a8fd00f3f91.jpg[/img]

SPECIAL GUEST ANNOUNCEMENT
Jeremy Pourcy is emerging from the shadows for LOUISIANA RETRO CON FALL 2023!
Jeremy is the owner and head developer of a NEW Louisiana-based indie video game studio known as Jrago Studios. His very first video game, Jrago The Demon Hunter, just recently launched on Steam on June 30th, 2023! 
The video game is an inspiration of the classic Castlevania/Metroid (Metroidvania) play-styles from the golden retro ages of gaming. 
Jeremy will be showcasing and demoing the game throughout the course of the convention, so be sure to stop in and talk with him! 
Come meet Jeremy Pourcy of Jrago Studios, and many other great guests this SEPTEMBER!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43100733/e3c5f0cfe1f1c02f0b98073d42751b107100763b.jpg[/img]

Come out for a full day of fun at the biggest video game convention in Louisiana. Louisiana Retro Con Fall 2023 is shaping to be our largest and most diverse event yet, with over 10,000 square feet of vendors and attractions! Tickets will only be $10 per person, and children 12 and under get in FREE!

Play FREE video games in the Retro Con Arcade area! Enter our FREE cosplay contest for a chance to be the star at LRC! Feeling a shopping itch? Check out our vendor area!

If you're a big game collector, then Louisiana Retro Con has something to offer to everyone. You will not find this many video games at another LA trade show, convention, or swap meet!

We will also proudly have multiple local artists, comic book vendors, retro toy vendors, and many more nerdy things worth checking out! FOOD WILL BE AVAILABLE ON SITE! Enjoy delicious food from one of our multiple on-site food vendors!

Louisiana Retro Con is a video game-focused convention that celebrates all things within the gaming spectrum. The event also showcases local artists, comic book authors, toy/comic vendors, and many more exhibits relevant to nerd culture. Proudly maintaining a very family-friendly setting, Louisiana Retro Con is a fun event for all age groups. Our next big event is LOUISIANA RETRO CON FALL 2023, set to be taking place from 11 AM - 6 PM on September 9th, 2023 in the spacious Morgan City Municipal Auditorium.
